title: 2027 Kyoto University Amgen Scholars Program
about: Kyoto University invites undergraduates in science-related programs at Asian colleges and universities to apply for its 2027 Amgen Scholars Program, held 4 June to 5 August 2027 in Kyoto, Japan. All application materials are due 1 February 2027, 3 p.m. JST.
requirements: Undergraduates in science-related programs at Asian colleges and universities; master's and doctoral students are not eligible

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: field "Science-related research" → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

undergraduate research programme → objective "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
